Soothing JujuRank 1
255% of base mana
Instant cast
Soothe an enemy, healing them and up to 5 allies within 30 yds for 26+0+SP*0.65, increasing the cost of your next Soothing Juju by 11%, stacking 5 times. Each additional ally beyond the first is healed for 15% less.

Can only be used while channeling a Witch Doctor spell upon the target.
